secondary_shortcut_name: trying stages in increasing order yields the lexicographically smallest solution
removal_suggestion: This is intrinsic to the task: pairwise unequal assignments over three stages are exactly proper 3-coloring. Rephrasing the separation rule or the stage names would not remove the shortcut without changing the problem's structure.
